Adani Green Energy Reaches 20 GW Renewable Capacity Milestone

Adani Green Energy has achieved a significant milestone, crossing 20 gigawatts (GW) of operational renewable energy capacity. This achievement positions the company as the first Indian firm to reach this capacity through greenfield development. The company's board is also scheduled to meet to approve financial results for the June quarter.
